tools.name: animation_physics
tools.description: Author animation and physics assets: Animation Blueprints, blend spaces, montages, Control Rig/IK, skeletons, sockets, physics assets, cloth, ragdolls, and vehicles.

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

addMissing.description: Whether to add the morph target when the component does not already carry it.

additive.description: Make the poses additive against pose 0, as facial and corrective poses are (default false).

animations.description: Animation asset paths to play in this state; one Sequence Player is created per entry and the first drives the state Result pose. Without it the state is created empty and the character holds its reference pose.

artifacts.description: Canonical /Game asset paths to delete during cleanup.

assets.description: Canonical /Game animation asset paths to retarget.

assignToMesh.description: Assign the new asset to the skeletal mesh.

autoMap.description: Map every unmapped chain: exact name matches first, then the closest names (default false).

automaticRule.description: Fire the transition when the source state's sequence player reaches the end of its animation instead of testing a condition. Left alone when omitted.

axis.description: Axis to change: X or Horizontal (default), Y or Vertical.

basePoseAnimation.description: Animation sequence to take the additive base pose from.

basePoseFrame.description: Frame used as the additive base pose.

basePoseType.description: Additive base pose type (RefPose, AnimScaled, AnimFrame).

bidirectional.description: Whether the transition also applies from toState back to fromState. Left alone when omitted.

blendOption.description: Blend curve; left as it is when omitted.

blueprintPath.description: Animation Blueprint whose AnimGraph is edited.

bodyForAll.description: Create a body for every bone regardless of size.

bodyType.description: Physics body primitive type (Sphere, Box, Capsule).

boneName.description: Shorthand for one layer filtering this bone and its children; ignored when layerSetup is sent.

boneTracks.description: Bone tracks to key: [{ boneName, frames: [{ frame, rotationDelta?: {pitch,yaw,roll}, rotation?: {pitch,yaw,roll}|{x,y,z,w}, location?: {x,y,z}, scale?: {x,y,z} }] }]. Channels left out keep the reference pose of that bone, so a rotation-only track poses without collapsing the skeleton. Prefer rotationDelta, which bends the bone relative to its rest orientation; plain rotation replaces the local rotation outright and needs the rest orientation to already be known.

center.description: Physics body centre offset relative to its bone as [x, y, z].

clothAssetName.description: Name of a clothing asset already registered on the mesh.

clothAssetPath.description: Clothing asset to load and register before binding.

clothOp.description: Which bind cloth to skeletal mesh variant to run; omit for 'bind'.

conditionComparison.description: How conditionVariable is tested: greater (default), less, greater_equal, less_equal for a numeric variable; true or false for a bool.

conditionValue.description: Right-hand value for a numeric conditionComparison (default 0). Ignored for true/false.

conditionVariable.description: Animation Blueprint variable the transition rule tests, e.g. Speed or bFalling. Without it the rule graph is left unconnected, which reads as false forever and the state machine never leaves its entry state.

connectToOutput.description: Wire the blend node into the AnimGraph output pose (default true).

constraintName.description: Name of the created physics constraint.

createIfMissing.description: Create the curve when the sequence does not have it (default true).

crossfadeDuration.description: Transition blend duration in seconds. blendTime is accepted as an alias.

direction.description: positive_to_negative (default: the positive side is copied onto the negative side) or negative_to_positive.

dropRenderOnlyMorphs.description: The edit rebuilds the mesh from its source data, which deletes morph targets that exist only in render data (made by create_morph_target or set_morph_target_deltas). Without true, a mesh that has any is refused with RENDER_ONLY_MORPHS naming them and nothing changes (default false).

edit.description: Which configure anim graph node variant to run.

element.description: Which remove skeleton element variant to run.

endFrame.description: Last frame of the notify state range.

engine.description: Engine settings: maxRPM, maxTorque, gears (forward gear count).

forceRootLock.description: Whether root motion is force-locked to the reference pose.

geomType.description: Body primitive: Sphyl, Box, Sphere, TaperedCapsule, MultiConvexHull or SingleConvexHull.

gridDivisions.description: Number of grid divisions on the axis.

groupName.description: Slot group the slot belongs to (default DefaultGroup).

info.description: Which get skeleton info variant to run; omit for 'skeleton'.

interpolationTime.description: Input smoothing time in seconds for every axis (0 turns smoothing off).

interpolationType.description: Input smoothing type for every axis; it only acts while interpolationTime is above 0.

kind.description: Which create animation asset variant to run; omit for 'asset'.

length.description: Capsule length between the end caps (default 20).

limits.description: Angular limits. Only the axes named change; an angle without a motion makes that axis Limited.

location.description: World or relative location as [x, y, z].

minBoneSize.description: Bones smaller than this get no body.

modularRig.description: Create a Modular Rig (UE 5.5+; older engines report modularRig false).

morphTargets.description: Names to import (default all the source mesh has in its source data).

name.description: Asset name (alternative to outputPath).

nodeId.description: The node GUID; an alternative to nodeName.

notifyClass.description: AnimNotify (or AnimNotifyState) class name; prefixed with AnimNotify_/AnimNotifyState_ automatically when missing.

outputPath.description: Canonical /Game path for the SkeletalMesh this writes.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing asset with the same name.

parentClass.description: AnimInstance subclass the Blueprint derives from (default AnimInstance): a native class name or an Animation Blueprint path.

path.description: Canonical /Game output path for the created asset.

physicsAssetName.description: Name of the generated Physics Asset.

poseNames.description: Distinct names for the poses in frame order; frames without a name keep the engine default name.

positionX.description: Graph X position of the new node (default 0).

positionY.description: Graph Y position of the new node (default 0).

priorityOrder.description: Evaluation order when several transitions out of one state can fire on the same frame; the lowest wins.

propertyName.description: The property: a member of the node's settings struct (Alpha, PlayRate, bLoopAnimation, Sequence) or of the graph node (NodeComment), with dots for a nested one (Node.PlayRate). On an asset player the asset property (Sequence, BlendSpace) is written through the node's own setter and read back, and fails when the node did not take it; any other property is written by reflection and its stored value read back.

ragdoll.description: Which setup ragdoll variant to run; omit for 'setup'.

relativeLocation.description: Socket location relative to its attach bone as [x, y, z].

relativeRotation.description: Socket rotation relative to its attach bone as [pitch, yaw, roll].

relativeScale.description: Socket scale relative to its attach bone as [x, y, z].

removeChildren.description: Whether child bones are removed with the target bone.

retargeterPath.description: An existing IK Retargeter to bake through. Omit to auto-build one by characterizing both skeletons and mapping their chains.

rootBoneName.description: Root bone name for the created skeleton.

oneOf.description: Box or capsule rotation relative to the bone as [pitch, yaw, roll].
Rotation as [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees.

rotation.description: Box or capsule rotation relative to the bone as [pitch, yaw, roll].

sampleValue.description: Sample position: a number on a 1D blend space, or {x, y} (or [x, y]) on a 2D one.

save.description: Save the asset to disk after the change (default true). With false the change stays in memory only and is lost when the editor restarts.

oneOf.description: Uniform scale factor, or non-uniform scale as [x, y, z].
Bone scale as [x, y, z] (default [1, 1, 1]).

skeletalMeshPath.description: A skeletal mesh whose skeleton to read, instead of skeletonPath.

slotName.description: Name of the montage slot (default DefaultSlot).

socketOp.description: Which configure socket variant to run; omit for 'configure'.

sourceAnimationPath.description: AnimSequence whose key frames become the poses; its skeleton is used.

sourceChain.description: Source IK Rig chain that drives it; empty or None clears the mapping.

sourceMesh.description: SkeletalMesh giving the source proportions. Defaults to the skeleton preview mesh, then any mesh in the project built on it.

sourceMeshPath.description: Skeletal mesh that owns the morph targets (its LOD 0 source data).

sourceSkeletalMesh.description: An already-skinned mesh on the same skeleton to copy weights from, such as the body the garment is worn over. Beats computing weights fresh wherever the garment hugs the body. Falls back to smooth binding when omitted.

startFrame.description: First frame of the notify state range.

stateMachineName.description: Target state machine name inside the Animation Blueprint.

staticMeshPath.description: StaticMesh to skin, e.g. a coat downloaded as a rigid mesh.

suffix.description: Suffix appended to each retargeted asset name.

targetChain.description: Target IK Rig chain to map; required unless autoMap.

targetMesh.description: SkeletalMesh to retarget onto. Defaults the same way as sourceMesh.

targetMeshPath.description: Skeletal mesh whose weights are replaced in place.

targetWeightInterpolationSpeed.description: Sample weight speed per second (0 turns weight smoothing off).

threshold.description: Influences below this weight are removed, above 0 and below 0.5 (default 0.01).

trackIndex.description: Notify track index within the animation sequence.

transitions.description: Transitions to create between the listed states, as [{ sourceState, targetState }].

transmission.description: Transmission settings: finalDrive and forward gearRatios.

treeName.description: Comment/name for the blend node (alias of name).

oneOf.description: Property value (any type).
The value: a number, boolean or string, an {x,y,z} or {r,g,b,a} object for a struct, or for an asset property the asset path (/Game/Anims/A_Idle).

vehicleType.description: Vehicle movement to set up; only a wheeled vehicle is supported (default WheeledVehicle4W).

weights.description: Per-vertex skin weight descriptors with bone influences.

wheels.description: Wheel setups, replacing the existing ones: [{ boneName, offset {x,y,z}, radius, width, friction }].

tools.name: build_environment
tools.description: Build environments: landscapes, foliage, procedural terrain/biomes, lighting setups, spline roads/rivers/fences, and world decoration.

actorName.description: Actor name in the current level.

area.description: A box min..max. Painting: instances spread evenly over min..max in X and Y, and each drops onto the ground found between 500 above max.z and 1000 below min.z. Removing: only the instances whose location lies inside min..max on all three axes (a pit or a path), every type unless foliageType names one.

items.description: A box min..max. Painting: instances spread evenly over min..max in X and Y, and each drops onto the ground found between 500 above max.z and 1000 below min.z. Removing: only the instances whose location lies inside min..max on all three axes (a pit or a path), every type unless foliageType names one.

areas.description: Several area boxes at once, each {min, max}: every instance inside any of them is removed under one consent (every type unless foliageType names one).

assetPath.description: Canonical /Game static mesh path (one asset; assetPaths takes several).

azimuth.description: Sun azimuth in degrees: the yaw of the light.

bClosedLoop.description: Whether the spline is a closed loop.

bounces.description: Lightmass indirect lighting bounces (World Settings), used by baked lighting.

captureSource.description: What the capture renders: FinalColorLDR, SceneColorHDR, SceneDepth, BaseColor, Normal or an SCS_ value. Required.

channelTarget.description: Which set light channel variant to run; omit for 'light'.

closedLoop.description: Close the spline into a loop, joining the last point back to the first.

collisionEnabled.description: Collision of placed instances: true = query and physics, false = none.

color.description: Light color {r, g, b, a}. Linear 0-1 channels, stored by the engine as the 8-bit sRGB color: {r: 1, g: 0.7, b: 0.42} reads back as (255, 218, 173). A missing channel reads 0 (alpha 1). properties.color wins over it.

count.description: How many instances to place over the brush disc (location + radius) or the area; overrides density.

cubemapPath.description: Cube texture the sky light uses (switches its source to a specified cubemap); a path that does not load fails the call.

curvePath.description: The curve asset to edit, created there when missing (default /Game/Environment/Curves/MCP_SkyColorCurve or MCP_LightColorCurve).

directionalLightActorPath.description: Directional light actor path. As input, selects the light to snapshot; the first directional light in the level is used when omitted. As output, the resolved actor path.

edit.description: Which edit landscape variant to run.

elevation.description: Sun elevation: degrees above the horizon (90 = overhead, negative = below it).

enabled.description: Indirect lighting cache on (point sampled) or off for each primitive.

feature.description: Which configure ray tracing variant to run.

foliageOp.description: Which add foliage variant to run; omit for 'scatter'.

items.description: Foliage type with mesh and density.

forwardAxis.description: Spline mesh forward axis (X, Y, Z).

index.description: Insert the point before this index; appended when omitted or out of range.

indirectLightingIntensity.description: Indirect lighting intensity, written with its override on the level's post-process volume (spawned when missing).

infiniteUnbound.description: Whether the volume is infinite and unbound.

items.description: Spline point with a world location.

keys.description: Color keys that replace the curve's keys; required to change an existing curve. A new curve without keys is flat white.

time.description: Key time, e.g. the hour of day.

color.description: Color {r, g, b, a}; a defaults to 1.

kind.description: Which create atmosphere actor variant to run.

landscapeActorPath.description: Landscape actor path in the level.

layerInfoPath.description: Layer info asset to use when the landscape has no layer of that name yet (else one lives only inside the landscape).

levelName.description: Level name; appended when path is a folder.

lightClass.description: Light class name or path, for a class lightType does not name, including a Blueprint light (/Game/Lights/BP_Lamp.BP_Lamp_C); build_environment list_light_types lists the loaded ones. Wins over lightType.

lightType.description: Light kind: point, spot, directional, rect or sky (any case), or the class name PointLight, SpotLight, DirectionalLight, RectLight or SkyLight. A light class of your own goes in lightClass.

limit.description: Return at most this many instances; truncated says when more exist (count stays the total).

oneOf.description: Brush centre in world space; paints the disc of radius around it (radius required).
Proxy location (default the landscape's).
Where the actor is spawned when it does not exist yet; an existing actor is not moved.
Where the actor is spawned when the level has none; an existing actor is not moved.
World location {x, y, z}; 0, 0, 300 when omitted.
World-space location {x, y, z}.

location.description: Brush centre in world space; paints the disc of radius around it (radius required).

lowerTerrain.description: Whether the spline lowers the terrain down to it (default true).

material.description: Material for the terrain; a path that does not load fails the call.

method.description: Auto-exposure method written on the post-process volume.

name.description: Label of the terrain actor (default ProceduralTerrain; actorName is accepted too).

noWeightBlend.description: Disable weight blending for the landscape layer.

operation.description: Heightmap operation: set, add, subtract, smooth.

outputPath.description: Filesystem path the heightmap is written to.

pointType.description: Spline point type (Linear, Curve, Constant, etc.).

items.description: Spline point with position and tangent.

properties.description: Light component settings, applied to the lights they fit; the reply lists what went in as details.applied, what did not as details.refused ("name: why") and any value replaced for being out of range as details.adjusted. Keys: intensity (0 or more; a negative reads 0), color (as above), castShadows (true or false), useAsAtmosphereSunLight (true or false; a directional light given properties is the atmosphere sun unless this says false), attenuationRadius (above 0, point and spot lights; an invalid value reads 1000), innerConeAngle and outerConeAngle (0 to 180 degrees, spot lights; clamped), sourceWidth and sourceHeight (above 0, rect lights; an invalid value reads 100). A sky light takes only the top-level intensity and color. Any other key, or one that does not fit the light, is refused by name.

quadsPerSection.description: Quads per section: 7, 15, 31, 63 (default), 127 or 255. A component spans sectionsPerComponent sections.

quality.description: Ambient occlusion quality on the post-process volume (25, 50 or 100 of 100).

radius.description: Ambient occlusion radius in world units.

raiseTerrain.description: Whether the spline raises the terrain up to it (default true).

rayTracedShadows.description: Whether ray-traced shadows are enabled (r.RayTracing.Shadows). Distinct from virtualShadowMaps.

recapture.description: Recapture the sky light after the change.

oneOf.description: Actor rotation, applied on every call.
Proxy rotation (default the landscape's).
Rotation {pitch, yaw, roll} in degrees. A spot or directional light shines along its forward axis, so pitch -90 points it straight down.
Rotation {pitch, yaw, roll}.
Water body rotation, applied on every call.

rotation.description: Actor rotation, applied on every call.

save.description: Whether to save after the operation.

sculptOp.description: Which sculpt variant to run; omit for 'sculpt'.

sectionSize.description: Quads per section (same as quadsPerSection): 7, 15, 31, 63 (default), 127 or 255.

sectionsPerComponent.description: Sections per component side: 1 (default) or 2, for 2x2 sections per component.

setting.description: Which configure atmosphere variant to run.

oneOf.description: Action-specific settings key-value pairs.

FPostProcessSettings fields by engine name, e.g. {"ColorSaturation": {"x": 1.1, "y": 1.1, "z": 1.1, "w": 1}, "VignetteIntensity": 0.3}; each field's bOverride_ flag is set for you. A key that is not a field is listed under unsupportedSettings, and when no key is one the call fails naming the closest fields.
Landscape properties by name, e.g. {"MaxLODLevel": 2, "LODDistributionSetting": 1.5}.

Property values for the actor or its component, keyed by the Unreal property name (case-insensitive): {"Intensity": 2, "LightColor": {"R": 0.6, "G": 0.7, "B": 1}} for a light, {"FogDensity": 0.02} for fog. A key neither declares is named in configurationErrors and fails the call.
Reflection capture component properties by name, e.g. {"Brightness": 1.5}.
The same shadow keys as the top level, nested; a value here wins.

shadowBias.description: Shadow depth bias of the light (actorName).

shadowQuality.description: Shadow quality scalability level (sg.ShadowQuality): Low, Medium, High, Epic or Cinematic.

shadowResolutionScale.description: Shadow resolution scale of the light (actorName).

shadowSlopeBias.description: Shadow slope bias of the light (actorName).

size.description: Box size in world units {x, y, z} (default 1000 on each axis).

skipFlush.description: Skip flushing rendering after the operation.

skyLightActorPath.description: Sky light actor path. As input, selects the light to snapshot; the first sky light in the level is used when omitted. As output, the resolved actor path.

skyLightOp.description: Which create sky light variant to run; omit for 'create'.

snapToSurface.description: Drop each point onto the first static surface below it (default true). Points with no surface below - over a pit or off the level - are skipped and reported as skippedNoSurface.

splineType.description: Point type for every point: Linear, Curve (default), Constant, CurveClamped or CurveCustomTangent.

summary.description: Count only: byType and count, no instance list. A level-wide listing runs to tens of KB.

targetActor.description: Target actor name for the operation.

tool.description: Sculpt tool: Raise (default), Lower or Flatten (towards the location's z). Any other name is refused.

useRandomOffset.description: Apply a random offset to scattered meshes.

viewDistance.description: Volumetric fog view distance in world units.

virtualShadowMaps.description: Whether virtual shadow maps are enabled. Distinct from rayTracedShadows.

volumeName.description: Label of the procedural foliage volume (name is accepted too).

width.description: Spline width in world units (default 256); side falloff is half of it.

tools.name: control_actor
tools.description: Spawn actors, set transforms, enable physics, add components, manage tags, and attach actors.

actorClass.description: Alias of classPath accepted by the spawn handler (normalizeArgs alias).

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

oneOf.description: Actor names to act on (batch delete).

Several actors to give the same material in one call and one undo step, in place of actorName; each is reported under results, and the actors changed under affectedActors (which the receipt lists as changes, with an actor handle each); the call fails naming any that did not take it.

Several actors to show or hide in one call and one undo step, in place of actorName; names not found are listed back under missing, and the actors changed under affectedActors (which the receipt lists as changes, with an actor handle each).

Several actors to tag in one call and one undo step, in place of actorName; names not found are listed back under missing, and the actors tagged under affectedActors (which the receipt lists as changes, with an actor handle each).

Several actors to toggle in one call and one undo step, in place of actorName; names not found are listed back under missing, and the actors changed under affectedActors (which the receipt lists as changes, with an actor handle each).

actorNames.description: Actor names to act on (batch delete).

oneOf.description: Actors to spawn, 1-500. Each is a spawn payload: classPath, blueprintPath or meshPath, plus actorName, location, rotation, scale ([x, y, z] arrays). Optional per item: materialPath (applied like set_material; componentName/materialSlot/allComponents narrow it), variables ({name: value} Blueprint variables set on the new instance, like set_blueprint_variables), folder (outliner folder path), tags (actor tags; delete_by_tag removes the batch again). Items that fail are reported; the rest still spawn.

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

location.description: World or relative location as [x, y, z].

offset.description: Move by [dx, dy, dz] from where the actor stands now, instead of to an absolute location; give one or the other.

rotation.description: Rotation as [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees.

oneOf.description: Many actors in one call, each {actorName, location? or offset?, rotation?, scale?} with its own values (an omitted part keeps its current value); every actor is reported, and the call fails naming any that did not move.

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

variables.description: Blueprint variable name to value map.

oneOf.description: Many actors in one call, each {actorName, variables} with its own values; every actor is reported, the actors that took a variable come back under affectedActors (which the receipt lists as changes, with an actor handle each), and the call fails naming any that did not take all of its variables.

actors.description: Actors to spawn, 1-500. Each is a spawn payload: classPath, blueprintPath or meshPath, plus actorName, location, rotation, scale ([x, y, z] arrays). Optional per item: materialPath (applied like set_material; componentName/materialSlot/allComponents narrow it), variables ({name: value} Blueprint variables set on the new instance, like set_blueprint_variables), folder (outliner folder path), tags (actor tags; delete_by_tag removes the batch again). Items that fail are reported; the rest still spawn.

allComponents.description: When true, apply the material to all mesh components.

blueprintPath.description: Audit the mesh parts of this actor Blueprint instead of the level: a preview instance (the level is untouched) has every visible static mesh part measured against every other and against its ground (a Character's capsule bottom). problems[] then lists componentName, kind (buried: inside otherComponent; sunk: below the ground), depth and severity in cm, insideShare and the issue; minSeverity is the tolerance (default 0.5 cm). A part tagged mcp.placement.ok in its ComponentTags is a deliberate embed (an eyeball in its socket) and is left out; mcp.placement.ok:<component> accepts the embed in that one part only and keeps every other check. Blueprint component edits report the same for the parts they touch, as partWarnings.

class.description: Unreal class name or path (alias of className).

className.description: Only actors of this class or a subclass, by name or path: TextRenderActor, Light (every light type), or a Blueprint such as BP_Sign, with or without _C.

classPath.description: Unreal class path (e.g. /Script/Engine.PointLight or /Game/Enemies/BP_Bug) of the actors to find (alias of className).

componentName.description: Target component name on the actor.

componentNames.description: Return only these components, by name (case-insensitive); a name that matches none is listed under missingComponents.

defaults.description: Fields shared by every item (e.g. meshPath, materialPath, folder, tags); an item's own fields win.

deleteScope.description: Which delete variant to run; omit for 'actors'.

distance.description: How far each face moves, in world units (0.1-20, default 1): far enough for the depth buffer, too little to see.

dryRun.description: List the moves without making them (default false).

durationSeconds.description: Game seconds to watch (default 2, at most 30). Game time, so a clock slowed with set_game_speed still covers the same span of play; a run that needs more wall-clock time than maxRealSeconds stops there (endedBecause realTimeCap).

edit.description: Which edit component variant to run.

filter.description: Optional name substring filter for list.

folder.description: Only actors in this outliner folder or a folder under it (Level/Stage matches Level/Stage/Signs); "(none)" for the actors at the root.

force.description: Force vector to apply as [x, y, z].

info.description: Which get components variant to run; omit for 'components'.

key.description: Key name as simulate_input takes it: SpaceBar, D, A, Left, Enter.

atSeconds.description: Game seconds after the run starts to press it (default 0).

inputs.description: Keys pressed and released at exact game times during the run (at most 32), e.g. [{"key":"D","atSeconds":0,"holdSeconds":2},{"key":"SpaceBar","atSeconds":0.6,"holdSeconds":0.2}]. A key still held when the run ends is released.

intervalSeconds.description: Game seconds between samples (default 0.05; 0 samples every frame). At most 400 samples are kept.

kinds.description: Report only these problem kinds, e.g. ["coplanar"] to list z-fighting alone in a platformer full of platforms that float on purpose. An actor whose worst problem is another kind still counts for coplanar when it has coplanarFaces. An actor whose bounds touch or overlap another actor's vertical face (a window band on a hall, an awning on a facade) is mounted, never floating or unsupported. Omit for every kind.

oneOf.description: Maximum number of actors to return in a list.
Maximum problem entries to return (1-200, default 25). Entries come worst-first, so a small limit still shows the placements that matter; flagged is always the true total.
Most actors to return (1-1000, default 200); a longer match list is cut and reports truncated and totalCount.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return in a list.

location.description: World or relative location as [x, y, z].

materialIndex.description: Alias of materialSlot accepted by the material handlers (normalizeArgs alias).

materialPath.description: Canonical /Game material asset path to apply.

maxRealSeconds.description: Wall-clock cap (default 25, at most 50): the run stops here and reports how much game time it covered, so a long run or an editor throttled to 3 fps still answers before a client that gives up at 30 s. Raise it only for a client that waits longer.

maxTilt.description: Degrees off vertical an actor may lean before it is reported as tilted (1-90, default 30). Lean is the angle between the up vector of the actor and world up, so yaw never counts and a fully inverted actor reads 180. Raise it for a level whose props are deliberately strewn about; lower it to catch subtler leans.

meshPath.description: Canonical /Game mesh asset path to assign on spawn.

minSeverity.description: Drop findings whose severity (worst penetration, ground error, tilt displacement, or the side of the largest z-fighting patch, in world units) is below this. Use it to skip cosmetic grazes on a large level.

name.description: Actor name or search query.

nameFilter.description: Only examine actors whose label or object name contains this text (an actor that shares its label with another is reported by object name, e.g. StaticMeshActor_75). Omit to sweep the whole level.

near.description: A world point as [x, y, z] (an {x, y, z} object works too): list what is close to it, nearest first, each row with its distance. With radius, only actors whose bounds come within radius of the point; without it, every matching actor sorted by distance. Combines with filter, tag, className and folder.

newName.description: New name for the duplicate or renamed actor.

oneOf.description: Move by [dx, dy, dz] from where the actor stands now, instead of to an absolute location; give one or the other.
Spawn/duplicate offset as [x, y, z].
Skip this many matching actors; the next page starts at nextOffset from the previous reply.

offset.description: Move by [dx, dy, dz] from where the actor stands now, instead of to an absolute location; give one or the other.

parentActor.description: Parent actor name to attach to.

properties.description: Component property key-value pairs. Each key is a name or dotted path, as propertyName takes it (BodyInstance.CollisionEnabled works).

propertyName.description: Component property to read or write: a name (Intensity), or a dotted path through structs at any depth (BodyInstance.CollisionEnabled, LightmassSettings.bShadowIndirectOnly). A bare name that is not on the component itself resolves to the one struct member carrying it (CollisionEnabled reads and writes BodyInstance.CollisionEnabled); a name several structs carry is refused with the full paths to choose from.

oneOf.description: Actor properties read at every sample, e.g. ["bDead", "HP"], or a component's as "Component.Property" ("Visual.RelativeScale3D" catches a squash on landing); a name that resolves to nothing is listed under missingProperties.

Property or Blueprint variable names to read on every listed actor, returned per actor under properties, e.g. Kind and Content, or a component's as "Component.Property" (StaticMeshComponent.LDMaxDrawDistance, Visual.RelativeScale3D; the component by its name), keyed as asked. A name that an actor lacks, or whose component it lacks, is listed under missingProperties for that actor.

oneOf.description: SCS operations applied in order. Each entry is an object with `type` plus that operation's own fields; `type: "add_component"` also takes componentName, componentClass (or componentType), attachTo, transform, meshPath, materialPath and a nested properties bag; `type: "modify_component"` takes the same transform, meshPath, materialPath and properties for a component that already exists; transform is {location:{x,y,z}, rotation:{pitch,yaw,roll}, scale:{x,y,z}} (or those three directly on the operation), and a part left out keeps its current value, while a transform that cannot be applied (a part that is not an {x,y,z} or {pitch,yaw,roll} object or a three-number array, or a component with no transform) is named in warnings, not skipped, as is a meshPath or materialPath that does not load or that its component cannot take; `type: "attach_component"` (or "reparent") moves componentName under parentComponent (or attachTo/newParent). A failed operation is named in warnings, and the call fails when none applied. Each result carries instancesUpdated (placed copies that took the change, 0 included) with up to three of their paths, and a hint, repeated in warnings, when a mesh or material lands on a hidden component.

Steps run in order, 1-200. Each is {edit, ...that edit's own params}. Member steps come before the nodes that use them: add_variable (variableName, variableType as add_variable takes it: basic, class, struct, enum and container types, defaultValue, isPublic, category), add_function (functionName, inputs, outputs, pure, isPublic; its body steps set graphName to the function name; with an id, "$id" is its entry node and "$id_return" its return node, which exists when outputs are declared), add_event (customEventName and parameters, or componentName plus eventName for a component or Widget Blueprint widget delegate, e.g. PlayButton with OnClicked) and add_event_dispatcher (dispatcherName, parameters [{name, type}]). Node steps: create_node, connect_pins, set_pin_default_value, set_node_property, create_reroute_node. create_node also takes nodeType CallDelegate (memberName: a dispatcher), Message (memberClass: an interface, memberName: its function), AsyncTask (memberClass: the task or async-action class, memberName: its static factory; event graphs only) and FunctionResult (one more return node in a function graph). Optional per step: id (names the created node; later steps use "$id" in fromNodeId, toNodeId and nodeId), from and to ("$id.PinName" shorthand for connect_pins), pinDefaults (create_node only: {PinName: value} applied to the new node; a read-only pin such as Set Text's Value gets a MakeLiteral node wired into it). "$entry" is the graph's own entry node (a Construction Script or function graph starts there: from "$entry.then"). A create step without posX and posY is auto-placed, and once every step ran it moves beside a node it is wired to (right of what runs it, below-left of what reads it); one whose posX and posY overlap an existing node is placed at the nearest free position instead, and its result says where in placementWarning, so a crowded row never stops the batch (a single create_node call still refuses an overlap). Every function, variable, dispatcher and async factory a step names is checked before any step runs, so a misspelled one fails the batch with nothing applied; any other failure stops the batch at that step, and that step leaves nothing behind (a member step included), in whichever graph it ran.

operations.description: SCS operations applied in order. Each entry is an object with `type` plus that operation's own fields; `type: "add_component"` also takes componentName, componentClass (or componentType), attachTo, transform, meshPath, materialPath and a nested properties bag; `type: "modify_component"` takes the same transform, meshPath, materialPath and properties for a component that already exists; transform is {location:{x,y,z}, rotation:{pitch,yaw,roll}, scale:{x,y,z}} (or those three directly on the operation), and a part left out keeps its current value, while a transform that cannot be applied (a part that is not an {x,y,z} or {pitch,yaw,roll} object or a three-number array, or a component with no transform) is named in warnings, not skipped, as is a meshPath or materialPath that does not load or that its component cannot take; `type: "attach_component"` (or "reparent") moves componentName under parentComponent (or attachTo/newParent). A failed operation is named in warnings, and the call fails when none applied. Each result carries instancesUpdated (placed copies that took the change, 0 included) with up to three of their paths, and a hint, repeated in warnings, when a mesh or material lands on a hidden component.

categoryName.description: Category name (letters, digits, underscore, hyphen only).

channels.description: Trace channels (validated: letters, digits, underscore, comma, space, hyphen).

code.description: Python code to execute inline (1 MB max).

command.description: Alternate CVar name field (parsed as name + value).

connectionType.description: Trace connection type; network is restricted to loopback.

control.description: Which profile performance variant to run.

duration.description: Seconds after which the capture stops by itself (default: runs until stop_profiling).

enableBatching.description: Same as enabled; enabled wins when both are given.

enableInstancing.description: Dynamic instancing of mesh draw commands (r.MeshDrawCommands.DynamicInstancing).

enabledOnly.description: Return only plugins currently enabled for this project.

extension.description: Only files with this extension, e.g. png or json (a leading dot is ignored, case-insensitive).

file.description: Path to a .py file to execute.

filter.description: Case-insensitive plain text (not a regex) a line must contain; separate alternatives with | to match any of them (LoadMap|Bringing World).

info.description: Which get trace status variant to run; omit for 'status'.

jobId.description: The jobId package_project or launch_build returned. Omit to list the jobIds this editor session knows.

keepFile.description: false: hand the image back without leaving a file in Saved/Screenshots (refused with returnBase64 false, which would leave no output at all). Default true. Files already written are listed by list_output_files and removed by delete_output_file.

kind.description: Which run build variant to run.

launchViewer.description: Open the Unreal Insights application on the trace: default true for control=launch_viewer (start_unreal_insights), false for the other variants.

limit.description: How many files to return (default 100, max 500).

lines.description: How many of the newest matching lines to return, oldest first (default 100, max 1000).

maps.description: Maps to cook. Pass these when a map is reached by NAME at runtime (OpenLevel) rather than by reference, or the cooker will not find it.

minScreenRadius.description: Smallest screen radius an object needs to be occlusion tested (r.OcclusionCullMinScreenRadius).

minVerbosity.description: Least severe level to include (default log): error returns errors only, warning adds warnings, verbose returns everything. Editor source only; refused with the other sources.

name.description: CVar name (alternatively cvar, key, or command).

offset.description: How many of the newest matching files to skip (default 0); pass the previous reply's nextOffset to read the next page.

outputPath.description: Output /Game folder for the merged asset.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing trace file of that name (default false: an existing file is refused).

packageName.description: Package name for the merged asset.

parentName.description: Panel to add the child under (get_widget_info lists the panels); omitted, the root panel. A name that is not a panel fails with PARENT_NOT_FOUND.

path.description: Another single asset or folder path; validated alongside assetPath when both are given.

oneOf.description: Asset paths to validate.
Several project-relative file paths to delete in one call; each gets its own entry in results. Takes precedence over path.

pluginName.description: Plugin name exactly as reported by list_plugins (the .uplugin name, not the friendly name).

pluginState.description: Which enable plugin variant to run; omit for 'enable'.

recursive.description: For a folder path, include its subfolders (default true).

replaceSourceActors.description: Replace source actors in the level.

resolution.description: Maximum WxH for the PNG (e.g. "1280x720"), aspect ratio kept, never upscaled. Without it an image returned inline fits 1600x900.

returnBase64.description: Return the PNG inline as an image (default true); a capture also saves a file unless keepFile is false. With no resolution, an inline image is downscaled to fit 1600x900. false returns only the saved path and metadata, at the full viewport size.

root.description: Search only this output folder (default all four).

runsBack.description: With source previous: how many editor runs back to read (default 1, max 20). After a crash and one more restart, the crashed run is 2.

seconds.description: How long the game runs before it is closed (default 20, 5-120). Quitting or crashing sooner fails the run.

setting.description: Which configure display variant to run.

slop.description: Occlusion query bounds padding in world units (r.OcclusionSlop).

snapshotPath.description: Snapshot .utrace file name, resolved inside Saved/Profiling (default a generated name).

soundPath.description: Sound asset path (default the editor CompileSuccess cue).

source.description: editor (default): the editor log. build: the UnrealBuildTool log of the last compile, where the compiler errors behind "Live coding failed" go. livecoding: the Live Coding console log (patching and linking). previous: the log of the editor's previous run, e.g. why an editor that went away exited. Only filter and lines apply to build, livecoding and previous.

startTime.description: Seconds into the sound to start playing from (default 0).

traceFile.description: File mode: .utrace file name, resolved inside Saved/Profiling (default a generated McpInsights_<time>.utrace).

widgetId.description: Only "notification" (the default); any other value is refused.

widgetOp.description: Which create widget variant to run; omit for 'create'.

widgetPath.description: Full widget asset path such as /Game/UI/WBP_Menu; supplies name and savePath when they are omitted.

widgetType.description: Parent class: UserWidget (default) or another UserWidget subclass by name or path; anything else is refused.

window.description: With mode full_editor_window, which window to capture: a list index (2, or "2") or a case-insensitive substring of its title ("WBP_HubUI"). Omit for the main editor frame; responses list the open windows under windows[].

windowed.description: Show a 1280x720 window instead of rendering offscreen (default false: no window, no focus taken).
